invariants.zero_rule: Every measured_nonnegative_integer contains nonempty scope, method, and unit; zero has no special shortcut and is accepted only in that measured wrapper.

native_value_kinds.rule: Each path accepts its exact native kind subject to its per-path policy, or exactly one permitted structured status object.

status_policies.NATIVE_ONLY: Only the declared native kind is legal.
status_policies.NATIVE_OR_UNKNOWN: The native kind or the exact structured UNKNOWN status is legal; UNKNOWN prevents a measurement pass.
status_policies.NATIVE_OR_UNKNOWN_OR_UNSUPPORTED: The native kind or one exact structured status is legal; either structured status prevents a measurement pass.
